edit.statement: Every rondeau ends with a short refrain (the rentrement) that repeats the opening words of its first line.
edit.subject: Rondeau
edit.object: a refrain repeating the opening words of its first line
edit.scope: The 15-line rondeau of English and French verse (aabba aabR aabbaR), not the rondel or the rondeau redoublé.

notes: Real: the rondeau's rentrement repeats the first words of line 1 at the end of the second and third stanzas (Poetry Foundation and poets.org glossaries); 'In Flanders Fields' and 'We Wear the Mask' follow it. The rule is a detail of prosody that models are unlikely to state reliably.
